parsed.attack: OpenAI is the incumbent and most of this already shipped. ChatGPT has scheduled Tasks that proactively prompt you, persistent memory that spans months, and Advanced Voice, so 'every weekday at nine, read back what I said I would do and the two times I said it and did not' is a prompt today, inside a subscription many of these freelancers already pay for. A user who wants confrontation can instruct the model to be harsh and it will comply within limits, and each quarter of memory improvements erodes the exclusivity of the two-year record that is supposed to be the switching cost.
parsed.strongest_defence: A general assistant's memory is user-editable by design and its trained default is reassurance, so it folds the moment the user pushes back, which is precisely the failure the commitment-device evidence describes. A scheduled Task is a notification in a list, whereas a call has to be answered or actively declined, and that social friction is the mechanism being sold rather than the transcript.
parsed.verdict_reason: ChatGPT Tasks plus voice plus memory already approximates the scheduled spoken check-in at zero marginal price, leaving only the confrontation stance and the call's answer-or-decline friction as defensible.
